basis: Exterior south/east sides traced at outside wall face (south outer face y=885px = world y=0, matching building footprint's south edge; east outer face x=610px = world x=10m, matching footprint east edge). Interior partitions (west shared wall with center room, north shared wall/jog with room above) traced at a representative centerline consistent with the drawn CAD gridline (x=400 gridline through partition; jog vertices at y=701.5/755.5 taken from the partition wall's centerline as drawn). Calibration anchors are the actual outside wall faces at the footprint SW/NE corners (x:240->0m,610->10m; y:885->0m,135->20m), verified against the 10000mm and 20000mm overall dimension chains, not the offset extension/dimension line ticks. Openings: ext_door_south is the south exterior door jambs projected onto y=885 host line; int_door_north is the north partition door jambs on the y=701.5 host line.
note: Complete room contour is logical across apertures. Orange segments are proposed wall-hosted openings, not door leaves. Geometry pass does not validate the drawing or calibration.
panel_note: Left: clean original crop. Right: proposed contour and apertures. V labels follow the supplied ring. All JSON coordinates refer to the original image.
